comment: A KAROO BOUNCE MUST DETACH AN AURA ON THE LAND IT RETURNS (CR 704.5m / 301.5c). BounceKarooLand erased the land without the attachment-falls-off loop every other leaves-the-battlefield site runs, and because per-copy m_number is STABLE the aura kept pointing at the bounced land's number -- so replaying that same physical card RE-ATTACHED it for free. Traced on this exact board before the fix: T3 Forest#1 + Wild Growth#2->attachedTo:1; T3 play Simic Growth Chamber bounces Forest#1 to HAND while Wild Growth stays attachedTo:1; T5 replay Forest#1 and the aura is live again, two turns later, at no cost. The error favours the AI (a free bounce-and-rebuy the search can learn to exploit), which is why it needs a pinned fixture rather than a comment. The board is constructed because an enchanted-land-bounced-by-its-own-karoo state is not reliably reached by seed-driven play, and the deck is Fungus because it runs both halves (2 Wild Growth, 3 Simic Growth Chamber). The assertion is on the REPLAY turn, not the bounce turn: expect_attachment resolves a host by battlefield m_number, so while the host sits in hand a stale pointer already reads as <none> and the bug would hide. USER-flagged 2026-09-17: 'You need to be careful of bounce lands when there are land enchantments out.'
